# telnyx_inventory_coverage (Data Source)

How many phone numbers Telnyx has in stock, grouped as requested.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_administrative_area` (String) Filter by administrative area
- `filter_count` (Boolean) Include count in the result
- `filter_country_code` (String) Filter by country. Defaults to US One of `AT`, `AU`, `BE`, `BG`, `CA`, `CH`, `CN`, `CY`, `CZ`, `DE`, `DK`, `EE`, `ES`, `FI`, `FR`, `GB`, `GR`, `HR`, `HU`, `IE`, `IT`, `LT`, `LU`, `LV`, `MX`, `NL`, `NO`, `NZ`, `PL`, `PT`, `RO`, `SE`, `SG`, `SI`, `SK`, `US`.
- `filter_features` (List of String) Filter if the phone number should be used for voice, fax, mms, sms, emergency. Returns features in the response when used.
- `filter_group_by` (String) Filter to group results One of `locality`, `national_destination_code`, `npa`.
- `filter_npa` (Number) Filter by npa
- `filter_nxx` (Number) Filter by nxx
- `filter_phone_number_type` (String) Filter by phone number type One of `landline`, `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `inventory_coverage` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inventory_coverage))
